rca_of_issue: N/A - all issues from iteration_2 are fixed. Root cause of the 500 errors was SQLAlchemy async lazy-loading: after db.commit(), relationships like tenant.settings were expired and triggered lazy loads which fail in async context (MissingGreenlet). Fix: use selectinload() to eagerly fetch relationships before accessing them.
